BFS strategy visits pages in breadth-first order

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engineConfig = await createCrawlConfigFromJson(json: r'{"crawl_strategy":"bfs","max_concurrent":1,"max_depth":2}');
    final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine(config: engineConfig);
    final url = 'https://example.com';
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.crawl(engine, url);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages.length);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[1].url);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[2].url);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[3].url);
    stdout.writeln(result.pages[4].url);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
